remarks: Exquisite Colonial Home in Salem Straits Association. Discover this stunning Colonial residence nestled on over an acre in the prestigious Salem Straits Association. Seamlessly blending traditional charm with modern sophistication, this home, originally built in 1968 and thoughtfully expanded in 2008 and 2012, features an inviting open-concept layout. The gourmet kitchen boasts heated floors and opens to a spacious deck, perfect for entertaining guests. The luxurious master suite offers a private deck, an opulent bath, and three generous walk-in closets. Four additional ensuite bedrooms provide ample space and abundant natural light. The lower level is an entertainer's dream, featuring a home theater, recreational room, wet bar, and a sunroom that enhances the home's appeal. With five heating and cooling zones and a whole-house generator, comfort is assured year-round. Enjoy exclusive access to the association private beach and boat slip. Salem Straits is also just a short walk to Great Island, a 60-acre island on Long Island Sound that's now open to Darien residents as a park! Don't miss the opportunity to make it your own!  Actual property square footage is 6,800.
